labels.en: Constitution of the Empire of Japan

descriptions.en: Promulgated in 1889 and enforced in 1890; Articles 4, 5 and 55 define the Emperor’s role and ministerial responsibilities.
descriptions.zh-CN: 1889年公布、1890年施行；第4、5及55条规定天皇职权与国务大臣的职责。

descriptions.en: Promulgated in 1946 and enforced on 3 May 1947; it defines the Emperor’s symbolic role and vests executive power in the Cabinet.
descriptions.zh-CN: 1946年公布，1947年5月3日施行；规定天皇的象征地位，并将行政权赋予内阁。

labels.en: Enforcement of the Constitution of Japan

descriptions.en: The constitutional rules took effect on 3 May 1947, following promulgation on 3 November 1946.
descriptions.zh-CN: 宪法于1946年11月3日公布，至1947年5月3日施行。

labels.zh-CN: 日本内阁：宪法规定的职权

descriptions.en: Article 65 vests executive power in the Cabinet; Article 3 requires its advice and approval for the Emperor’s acts in matters of state.
descriptions.zh-CN: 第65条规定行政权属于内阁；第3条规定天皇的国事行为须经内阁建议与批准。

labels.en: National Diet of Japan: constitutional role
labels.zh-CN: 日本国会：宪法规定的职权

descriptions.en: Article 41 defines the Diet’s law-making status; Article 6 provides for the Emperor to appoint the prime minister designated by the Diet.
descriptions.zh-CN: 第41条规定国会的立法地位；第6条规定首相由国会指定、天皇任命。
